protocol.capture: for each route slot and output tile, intermediate row slot*16+tile stores gate[128]|up[128] as raw FP16 immediately before joint H128

decision_rule.localized_after_raw_fc1: observed-carrier gate and up both satisfy the numeric gate; continue instrumentation after the first joint H128
decision_rule.localized_at_or_before_raw_fc1: either observed-carrier projection fails; inspect stream decode, W13 scale/MMA geometry, and projection ordering

protocol.failure_policy: fail closed on identity drift, non-SM120, non-M1/full-coupled dispatch, capture-row collision or bounds error, missing debug carrier, nonfinite FP16 capture, or malformed projection geometry
protocol.input_prequant_trace: exactly 512 bytes in the MCG-dead trellis_lut ABI slot: raw K32 block40, normalized block40, raw block62, normalized block62 as FP32
protocol.isa_cost: mxf8f6f4 uses twice the MMA issue count of NVFP4
protocol.product: P8 K4 procedural MCG alpha2 to E4M3/UE8M0-K32
protocol.projection_contract: W13 trellis slot0=gate, slot1=up; physical W13 scale plane=up|gate
protocol.purpose: localize v4 middle-carrier divergence before or after raw W13 MMA
reference_arms: observed device E4M3/UE8M0 input carrier reconstructed in logical K order
